# Vendored browser libraries (race graphs)

Copied next to every race graph (`graphify-out/races/<run_id>/lib/`) so `graph.html`
and `dashboard.html` work offline (no internet at the venue).

| File | Version | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vis-network.min.js` | 9.1.6 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vis-network@9.1.6/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js | Apache-2.0 or MIT (dual) |
| `d3.min.js` | 7.9.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js | ISC |

Unmodified. Licence and copyright headers are kept at the top of each file.
